keyPhrases.text: Admire first the deftness of the storytelling
The show has its weaknesses, God knows
may aim only to be a shallow, big-budget, crowd-pleasing jukebox musical
threatens to collapse under Behind the Music clichés
You won't get the next Carousel by thinking that way

reasoning: Strong positive review with clear enthusiasm and recommendation. Acknowledges the show's limitations ('shallow,' 'clichés,' 'weaknesses') but consistently praises execution, entertainment value, and crowd appeal. Calls it a 'model of the genre' and 'triumph,' indicating solid 4-star territory with minor reservations.
